verdict.rationale: The Agents SDK is distributed as an open-source Python/JS library (github.com/openai/openai-agents-python) that developers install and run entirely within their own infrastructure, and it is explicitly provider-agnostic, supporting 100+ LLMs beyond OpenAI's own hosted models, so there is no vendor-hosted service dependency for the core orchestration logic. This inherently satisfies self-hosting since there is no SaaS backend required to run agents, tools, handoffs, or tracing locally.  Missing for 10: explicit first-party self-hosting/deployment guide, documentation of infra requirements for self-hosted tracing dashboard, and independent confirmation of a fully self-hosted production deployment.
